$comment: G2's data: every export of src/index.ts appears in exactly one demo's covers[]. The gate (scripts/docs-gate.mjs) fails on a missing OR stale name; gallery.test.tsx fails if a demo entry has no renderer, and runs axe on each (G3).

demos.title: Status language
demos.notes: One tone mechanism: StateBadge + statusTone over the semantic ramp; domain vocabularies are app-side `extra` maps. Unknown states render honest neutral.

demos.title: Banners
demos.notes: The kit's only message surface; tone from the ramp, live-region semantics chosen by the caller.

demos.title: Table
demos.notes: The ONE table: rounded card, toolbar inside the card, keyboard-reachable clickable rows (B7).

demos.title: Keyset table
demos.notes: Append-only keyset paging — the honest footer counts what is LOADED, never a total. aria-busy while loading (B7).

demos.title: Verb buttons
demos.notes: Confirm-before-verb is NOT optional; refusals render VERBATIM. executeVerb speaks the frozen AdminResult envelope.

demos.title: Run progress
demos.notes: Percentages from CHUNKS — the honest denominator; the deadline verdict is a pure function.

demos.title: Audit block
demos.notes: Old→new change rows; classified values are masked HERE as the second line of defence. Timestamps ride shortStamp's no-parse rule.

demos.title: Sheet & Dialog
demos.notes: Sheet is the home of entity DETAIL; Dialog is the home of forms and decisions. Shared modal chrome, `--overlay` token scrim.

demos.title: Facet filter & search
demos.notes: Selection travels to the SERVER as a filter; SearchBox commits on Enter/blur, never per keystroke.

demos.title: Tab strip
demos.notes: Pill tabs, roving tabindex, focus follows selection; `scope` prefixes the id pairing when two strips share item ids (B7).

demos.title: App shell
demos.notes: Grouped nav with icons, inset accent bar, collapse keeps the icons and persists; the shell owns scrolling.

demos.title: Command palette
demos.notes: ⌘K opens it; the trigger and the palette stay decoupled through the window event.

demos.title: Stat cards
demos.notes: The value arrives pre-formatted — the card computes nothing; the console invents no aggregate.

demos.title: Select, Checkbox, Switch
demos.notes: The family Select is a portal-free listbox (lives inside dialogs); disabled options are skipped; the list flips at the viewport edge (B2).

demos.title: Form fields
demos.notes: Field wires label + description + error ONCE (aria-labelledby / describedby / invalid); works with a spread register() and under a Controller (D4).

demos.title: Buttons & icon actions
demos.notes: Button is for everything that is NOT a mutating verb; danger wears the family's outlined tone. IconAction carries name + tooltip.

demos.title: Dropdown menu
demos.notes: The menu that STAYS a menu (D3): actions and navigation; CheckItem is a real menuitemcheckbox.

demos.title: Empty state
demos.notes: A void reads as intentional guidance: art, title, body, actions.

demos.title: Detail anatomy
demos.notes: The journal anatomy for Sheet interiors: dl/dt/dd rows, small-caps headings, honest copy button.

demos.title: Density
demos.notes: One rhythm for every family table, app-wide via context, persisted.

demos.title: Helpers
demos.notes: humanizeSeconds' coarse ladder; shortStamp's no-parse string surgery — server time is never shifted through Date.
